name: Hard oscillator sync: master sets pitch, slave pitch + mod envelope sets timbre
goal: Build a classic hard-sync lead voice where oscillator 1 (master) resets oscillator 2 (slave) each cycle so master pitch is the note and slave pitch is timbre; sweep slave pitch with a mod envelope (high amount, slave starting an octave down) for the characteristic sync squeal, then add tempo delay, short reverb, and pitch-bend for performance.

source.title: Oscillator Syncing in Thor (Patch Design in Thor)

prerequisites: Dual analog-style oscillators with a hard-sync switch
Mod envelope routable to oscillator pitch

inputs.name: slave_base_interval
inputs.description: Starting slave transpose relative to master (transcript uses −12 st)

constraints: Portable signal-flow recipe for Web Audio / Traveler-inspired / any hybrid synth with comparable modules; not affiliated with any vendor.
Do not copy proprietary factory preset banks, wavetable file names, or sample packs; use original/free waves or generic shapes.
Steps and numeric values are grounded only in the YouTube Show-transcript text; approximate where the speaker gestured without stating a number.
Only the slave needs to be heard for the sync timbre demo; master can be muted from the audio path while still resetting the slave.

steps.action: Init two oscillators. Enable hard sync so each time oscillator 1 completes a cycle it resets oscillator 2's phase. Raise amp-envelope sustain to full.
steps.expect: Sync engaged; notes sustain while held

steps.action: Mute/hear only the slave for clarity. Changing master octave changes perceived pitch even when only the slave is routed; changing slave pitch changes timbre, not the fundamental.
steps.expect: Master pitch = note; slave pitch = harmonic/timbre

steps.action: Set slave about one octave below master. Route mod envelope to slave pitch at nearly full amount (~94%). Give the mod envelope a little attack, fairly long decay, and release near zero. Bypass bright-cutting filters for a raw sync tone.
steps.expect: Each note squeals/sweeps harmonics as the envelope decays

steps.action: Add tempo-synced delay (transcript example: dotted/3+16th feel) with low dry/wet, set pitch-wheel range to ±12 st, and a short digital reverb at very low mix for space.
steps.expect: Lead sits in the mix with slap delay and slight air

steps.action: Perform with pitch-bend automation (full-range slides) and optional reverb dry/wet rides for breakdown/build gestures.
steps.expect: Expressive sync lead without needing filter sweeps

verification: Moving only slave pitch changes tone color while the melody pitch tracks master
Mod envelope creates an audible sync sweep on each note
Pitch bend spans ±1 octave when range is 12
